jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As part of Deutsche Börse Group — within the Product Development, Alternative Investments area — we continuously discover and develop brand-new solutions of the highest importance for our clients and the market.

We are seeking highly analytical professionals who are eager to create innovative solutions in a culture that values trust and teamwork. You will work with code based on C# and APL, and with many new technologies for cloud development in Azure.

As part of our international Scrum teams, you will play a crucial role in delivering solutions within our system, SimCorp Dimension, and the Azure cloud, while working closely with Product Managers and engaging directly with clients. You will also have the opportunity to learn about financial investments, including developing solutions for Alternative Investments.

What You Will Be Responsible For

You will apply your talents across all stages of the development lifecycle, including the creation and review of user stories, design, development, testing, coding, code reviews, writing automated tests, and support. You will be using multiple technologies, and your responsibilities will include:

Developing new functionality and continuously improving the existing code base
Working with backend and mid-tier technologies, as well as web frontend standards
Collaborating with your Scrum team to reach the definition of done within each sprint
Engaging with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and gather fast feedback
Continuously learning and improving yourself, your team, and our product — including working with modern engineering practices such as test-driven development, pair programming, and mob programming

What We Value

Most importantly, we want you to see yourself contributing and thriving in the role described above. We expect you to be proficient in several of the following areas and willing to learn the rest:

Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
Programming experience in C# using the .NET Framework
Knowledge of cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, and architecture — preferably on Azure
Familiarity and ideally hands-on experience with Azure Bicep, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, etc.
Understanding of modern web technologies and RESTful API communication
Interest in or experience with APL
Experience with automated testing
Ability to work with and develop complex architecture
Adaptability — able to pivot quickly when needed
Proactive, self-driven, and improvement-focused mindset
Strong communication skills and fluency in English (spoken and written)

Benefits

We offer a competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension — essentials for any work agreement. But at SimCorp, we believe in offering more. In addition to a traditional benefits package, we provide excellent work-life balance through flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model.

We also offer IP sprints — three weeks per quarter dedicated to mastering your skills and contributing innovative ideas to company development.

There is never just one path — we take an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continuously. Please note that only applications submitted through our system will be considered.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in our recruitment process.

If you're interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role.

The approximate time to review your CV is three weeks.

We are committed to continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we will ask for your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior AI Cloud Architect (AI Platform)- Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tietoevry Public 360 - building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

What You Will Do

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.

Nice to have

Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

Impact you will have

Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Tech we use

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

Practicalities

Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)

jobs.description:
Job Description

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.

Job Summary

The AI Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing secure, scalable and cost-efficient AI architectures for APAC deployments. The role defines technical standards, patterns and guardrails across models, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure and security layers, ensuring solutions align with global governance while meeting APAC data sovereignty and regulatory requirements. The role provides technical direction to the team, supporting the design, build, maintenance and continuous improvement of advanced AI and automation solutions. You will design and maintain the architecture for the AI enabled Marine Ground Digital Twin Platform.

This is a 3-year fixed term contract for placement in Singapore, and only open to SG/PR candidates.

Key Responsibilities

workflows.

.
You'll work directly with me as the founder, with significant ownership over the technical direction and how we build the company from the ground up.

What you'll own

Technical leadership & ownership

Explore and integrate AI/ML or computer vision where it genuinely adds value
Review and improve the existing POC and technical foundation

Who I am looking for

. The title matters less than your ability to take ownership of the technology
.

I am particularly looking for someone with:
Strong full-stack software development experience
Strong understanding of software architecture and system design
Experience building and deploying production applications
Experience with cloud infrastructure and modern development practices
The ability to make sound technical decisions independently

If you're interested — or know someone who might be a great fit — please send us a direct message or send your email over to davidtan.onetranspire@gmail.com

As an experienced .NET Software Engineer, you will play a key role in driving the success of our Supply Chain Management (SCM) applications and the technical development and scaling of our core enterprise systems. Full professional level; applies software engineering expertise in a specific area of specialization. Work is performed within established professional standards, technical guidelines and project objectives. Works on problems of moderate to diverse scope where analysis of technical requirements, system architectures and data schemas requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Exercises technical judgment within defined procedures and software development practices to determine appropriate action. Receives general instructions on routine development tasks and detailed instructions on new projects or complex system assignments. Builds productive collaborative relationships across development, QA and business analyst teams.
Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
● Contribute significantly to the architecture, design and end-to-end delivery of scalable enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and .NET 10.

● Collaborate closely with team members, sharing technical knowledge on modern .NET design patterns, coding standards and development best practices.
● Ensure application reliability and stability by defining and implementing code testing standards, structured debugging and proactive performance optimization.
● Proactively identify and resolve technical debt, modernize user interfaces and enhance application stability, security and performance.
● Collaborate with IT/Business partners, cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications.
● Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectural designs, system configurations and database schemas to ensure long-term maintainability.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies:

● Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem, with a strong passion for modern C# features and ASP.NET Core.
● Solid expertise in software design and architecture (Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture and Modular Design).
● Advanced proficiency in Database Architecture and SQL, with experience optimizing Entity Framework Core integrated with Oracle DB (experience with other relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server is highly acceptable).
● Competency in web development and frontend integration, combining ASP.NET Core MVC with JavaScript to build highly interactive, responsive and performant user interfaces using UI components (such as Telerik UI), along with basic HTML and CSS skills.
● Hands-on experience with version control and modern Git workflows (GitLab, branch protection, Merge Requests) along with exposure to CI/CD automation pipelines.
● Proven ability to work independently, take technical ownership of features, manage priorities and drive high quality standards through constructive code reviews.
● Flexibility to occasionally participate in technical discussions, business requirements alignment and specifications review with managers, architects and stakeholders in the Canada timezone (EST).
● Exceptional verbal and written English skills for cross-cultural collaboration, negotiating technical requirements and explaining complex .NET concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
● Self-driven, proactive mindset with a focus on writing highly scalable, long-term maintainable code and a desire to contribute to architectural discussions.
● Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment with a solid understanding of sprint cycles, collaborative delivery and continuous improvement is preferred.
● Understanding of Supply Chain Management (SCM) processes or ERP workflows is considered a strong asset (openness and willingness to learn these business processes is highly valued).
● Knowledge or experience with UI frameworks (e.g., Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core with Ajax Binding, Tag Helpers) is a strong asset.
● Prior knowledge of Java or Java ADF is not required, though any basic familiarity with these technologies is a welcome asset.
● Openness to utilizing modern development tools and AI-assisted engineering practices is preferred.

Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

5+ years of experience in a similar role spanning software development and .NET web applications delivery.

University degree in one of the following: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  Lab Automation

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to

models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The newComputational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients Worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

As a senior lab automation software engineer, you will be the essential link to the automation scientists in the lab. Using your background in both software development and hardware integration, you will work with a team of software-focused engineers to build, test and do what is needed to bring the software and hardware layers into production.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

Design, program and troubleshoot high-throughput lab workflows
Build orchestration systems, hardware abstraction layers, and instrument drivers that manage retries and allow unattended operation
Implement logging, metrics, and alerts across hardware and software to identify failures. Fix root causes using software or vision models instead of relying on manual workarounds or vendor support
Build systems to maintain a digital representation of the lab, including sample identity, instrument state, and resource availability. Connect instruments via APIs and integrate with LIMS and ELNs
Manage hardware requirements, site constraints, reagent selection, and work cell integration from initial design to deployment
Work directly with software engineers, automation scientists, and hardware engineers to turn scientific processes into technical architectures

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering and hardware integration
Experienced in programming commercial liquid-handling or laboratory automation platforms and integrating robotic manipulators
Proficient in C# or Python for building software and integration frameworks
Familiar with molecular biology, biochemistry, or wet lab workflows to help translate scientific needs into engineering solutions
Prototyping design experience, including CNC milling, laser cutting, and CAD
A clear communicator who collaborates with scientists and multidisciplinary teams to build complete solutions
Skilled at using APIs and SDKs to interact with complex laboratory software ecosystems
Experienced in designing workflow orchestration or scheduling systems that manage shared resources, dependencies, and priorities

Preferred Skills And Experience

Skilled with computer vision models (such as OpenCV, YOLO, or SAM) for automated error handling and object or anomaly detection
Experienced in training, evaluating, or adopting AI/ML models, including reinforcement or imitation learning for robotics
Capable of building and evaluating AI-enabled systems, defining evals, establishing guardrails for determinism versus nondeterminism, and measuring reliability
Knowledgeable about sensors, microcontrollers, and task-and-motion planning
Familiar with cloud infrastructure and digital twin simulation

A cover letter is not necessary, you will be required to fill a questionnaire.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity! #ComputationCoE

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: (Senior) Cloud Solution Architect – Microsoft Azure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Bei uns kommen AI-Kompetenz, Engineering-Exzellenz und fundiertes Branchenverständnis zusammen – getragen von Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. So entstehen zukunftsfähige Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Das gelingt durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und technologische Möglichkeiten in greifbare Ergebnisse verwandeln. Dafür schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist: Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, offene Communities, in denen Wissen gerne geteilt wird, Peer Groups und Trainingsangebote, die sich an dir orientieren. Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsam gefeierte Erfolge prägen dabei unser Miteinander und machen Entwicklung zu etwas, das bei uns einfach dazugehört.

DAS KANNST DU BEWEGEN

Azure Architektur: Du entwickelst moderne, sichere und skalierbare Azure-Architekturen und erstellst die Architekturplanung für die zu implementierende Lösung.
Cloud Foundation & Landing Zones: Du konzipierst Azure Landing Zones und gestaltest die technische Basis für Cloud-Transformationen – inklusive Management Groups, Subscriptions, Networking, Identity, Governance und Security.
Azure Migration & Modernisierung: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Analyse, Planung und Umsetzung von Migrationen nach Azure und entwickelst bestehende IT-Landschaften gezielt weiter.
Hybrid Cloud & Networking: Du konzipierst hybride Architekturen und verbindest bestehende On-Premises-Umgebungen sicher mit Azure – beispielsweise mit Azure Virtual Network, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints und Azure DNS.
Security & Identity: Du integrierst Security von Beginn an in deine Architektur und arbeitest unter anderem mit Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy und Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Du automatisierst den Aufbau von Cloud-Infrastrukturen mit Technologien wie Terraform oder Bicep und integrierst diese in moderne CI/CD-Prozesse mit GitHub oder Azure DevOps.
Cloud-native Lösungen: Du berätst unsere Kunden auch beim Einsatz moderner Azure Services wie Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps oder Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Integration & APIs: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Azure API Management, Service Bus und Event Grid und kannst diese sinnvoll in moderne Lösungsarchitekturen integrieren.
Betrieb & Resilienz: Du berücksichtigst Monitoring, Verfügbarkeit, Backup und Disaster Recovery bereits im Lösungsdesign und nutzt dafür beispielsweise Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup und Azure Site Recovery.
Governance & Kosten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Azure-Umgebung kontrollierbar und wirtschaftlich zu betreiben und berücksichtigst dabei Governance- und FinOps-Prinzipien.
Kundenberatung & Workshops: Du diskutierst Anforderungen auf Augenhöhe mit IT-Verantwortlichen und Architekten, moderierst Architektur- und Cloud-Workshops und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete technische Lösungen.
PreSales & Angebote: Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Microsoft-Team entwickelst du Lösungsansätze für neue Kundenprojekte und unterstützt bei Architekturkonzepten, Aufwandsschätzungen, Angeboten sowie Präsentationen.
Microsoft Ecosystem: Du arbeitest eng mit Microsoft und unseren internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten zusammen und bringst neue Azure-Technologien und Best Practices aktiv in unsere Kundenprojekte ein.
Teamarbeit: Du gibst dein Wissen weiter, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unser Microsoft Azure Portfolio weiter.

WIE DIR DAS GELINGT

Azure-Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und der Konzeption sowie Umsetzung von Azure-basierten Kundenlösungen mit.
Infrastructure Know-how: Du verstehst klassische und moderne IT-Infrastrukturen und kennst dich insbesondere mit Cloud Networking, Compute, Storage, Identity, Security und hybriden Architekturen aus.
Architekturkompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen analysieren, technische Optionen bewerten und daraus verständliche, sichere und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen entwickeln.
Azure Best Practices: Konzepte wie Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Landing Zones und Azure Well-Architected Framework sind dir vertraut.
Infrastructure as Code: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie mit Automatisierungs- und Deployment-Prozessen.
Security: Zero Trust, Identity & Access Management, Network Security, Governance und Cloud Security sind für dich integraler Bestandteil einer Architektur und keine nachgelagerten Themen.
Modernisierung: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit Azure Migrate sowie mit PaaS-, Container- oder Kubernetes-basierten Architekturen gesammelt.
DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps sowie CI/CD-Konzepte sind dir vertraut.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären, trittst beim Kunden sicher auf und entwickelst Lösungen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst gerne technische Verantwortung und möchtest Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern deren Umsetzung aktiv begleiten.
Zertifizierungen: Microsoft Azure Zertifizierungen wie Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) sind ein Plus – oder du bist bereit, entsprechende Zertifizierungen bei uns zu erlangen.
KI-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Reisebereitschaft & Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, projektbezogen zu reisen, und arbeitest gern in agilen Teams.

CHANCENGEBER - WAS ADESSO AUSMACHT

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, gemeinschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Lerne und wachse mit uns: Mit über 400 Trainingsangeboten und unserer digitalen Lernplattform unterstützen wir deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Gemeinsame Events (z.B. Sport-Weekend und die jährliche Fortbildungsreise eduCamp), Welcome Days, Firmenläufe stärken unseren Zusammenhalt und lassen dich von Anfang an Teil des Teams sein.
Engagement, das belohnt wird: Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus – mit Prämien für Empfehlungen, Vorträge, die Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten sowie attraktiven Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns – auch im Home-Office. Arbeiten in Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich (80-100%). Zum wiederholten Mal wurden wir zu einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz gekürt! Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

What You’ll Do

Be a Technical Reference: Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will drive architectural decisions for both backend services and frontend applications, establishing coding standards and best practices.
E2E Ownership: Own the definition, planning, execution, delivery, and monitoring of features in a production environment, ensuring high availability and performance.
Be Product-Driven: Pair with Product Managers on discovery, refinement, estimation, and prioritisation of new features, translating business requirements into technical specs.
Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and implement robust applications and event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus and Hangfire for background processing and asynchronous tasks.
Ensure Data Integrity: Manage and optimise database schemas, ensuring data consistency and query performance.
Collaborate on UX/UI: Engage closely with the Design Team, ensuring faithful implementation of our web strategy and contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our internal Design System, ensuring visual consistency and code reusability.
Champion Documentation: Create and maintain clear documentation for APIs, architecture diagrams, and system flows.
Master the Stack: .NET (C#), SQL/MySQL/PostgreSQL, Hangfire, Azure Service Bus, React/TypeScript, Azure, Terraform, CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines).

Who You Are

Experienced: You have at least 7 years of experience building and deploying distributed systems and web applications.
Backend Specialist: You have deep proficiency in .NET (C#) and a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Database Proficient: You are comfortable working with relational databases and know how to optimise them for scale.
Async & Background Processing: You have proven experience implementing background jobs (using Hangfire or similar) and event-driven architecture using message brokers (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc).
Frontend Capable: You are proficient with React and TypeScript, capable of building and maintaining functional and responsive UI components.
Quality Obsessed: You view automated testing (Unit, Integration) as a baseline for every feature and know how to integrate tests into a CI/CD pipeline.
Cloud Aware: Strong familiarity with Microsoft Azure and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) is highly valued.
Global Communicator: You are comfortable working with different time zones and thrive in an environment that values asynchronous communication and autonomy.

Training opportunities and free access to Udemy
Flexible benefits program

Engineering Manager (Hybrid)

Porto, Portugal

About Us

Nitro is a global document productivity company accelerating digital transformation in a world that demands the ability to work from anywhere, anytime, on any device. As a global player in the eSign and workflow productivity market, Nitro enables organisations to drive better business outcomes through 100% digital document processes and fast, efficient workflows. The Nitro Productivity Platform offers comprehensive SaaS business solutions, including highly secure eSigning and e-ID, powerful PDF productivity and industry-leading analytics, all supported by a superior customer success team. Nitro has over 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ Business Customers in more than 150 countries, including over 68% of the Fortune 500 and three of the Fortune 10. Nitro is headquartered in San Francisco with nine global hubs.

How We Work

We Aim To Create An Environment Where Talented Individuals Are Empowered To Excel. How We Collaborate, Innovate, And Engage With One Another Is Important To Us. Our Work Is Driven By 5 Key Principles:

One team, One mission

Our collective dedication to Nitro’s mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.

Own it

We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.

Accountable to our customers

We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.

Excellence in execution

Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.

Be bold, fail fast, learn faster

We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

Why Nitro Automate Platform

The Nitro Automate Platform is at the forefront of Nitro’s evolution – powering cutting-edge AI solutions that transform how businesses interact with documents and automate workflows. Our platform includes REST APIs for PDF and document manipulation, no-code workflow automation tools, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and deeply integrated AI capabilities.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an ambitious, high-impact team building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of intelligent document automation.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager
to lead and grow the engineering team behind the Nitro Automate Platform. You will manage talented engineers building real-world AI solutions – from document processing APIs to workflow automation tooling and MCP servers. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of engineering leadership and cutting-edge AI product development.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers delivering AI-powered APIs, document automation pipelines, and no-code workflow tooling
Drive the full engineering lifecycle from product specification through to production deployment, ensuring quality and velocity
Champion agentic coding workflows and modern AI-assisted development practices across your team
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and senior engineers to define technical direction and architectural standards for the Automate Platform
Own delivery and accountability for platform features including PDF/document alteration APIs, workflow automation services, and MCP server integrations
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and rapid iteration
Actively identify and mitigate technical risks and delivery dependencies
Lead stakeholder communication, providing clear visibility into team progress and technical decisions
Contribute to and help shape company-wide engineering best practices

Required Skills And Qualifications

3–5+ years as an Engineering Manager in a software development environment, with direct experience leading cross-functional engineering teams
Strong technical background in backend and/or API development, ideally in Python or similar modern languages
Hands-on experience with agentic coding workflows, AI-assisted development, and taking software from spec to production
Proven experience delivering cloud-native, production-grade APIs and developer-facing platforms
Experience working with AI/LLM technologies, automation frameworks, or document processing systems
Familiarity with MCP servers, no-code tooling, or workflow automation platforms is a strong advantage
Strong knowledge of CI/CD, modern DevOps practices, and agile/scrum methodologies
Excellent communication and leadership skills; comfortable influencing across engineering, product, and commercial stakeholders
Based in Porto, Portugal with the ability to collaborate regularly with our Dublin team

A Taste of Our Philosophy

We believe that engineering should be fun
The best products demand the best platforms, and that is exactly what we build
We are passionate about instrumentation, continuous improvement and operational excellence
We are committed to building systems and services that just work, without heroics
We not only believe in your personal and professional growth, we expect it

Why Nitro?

Along With Our Regular Benefits And Programs (including Health, Dental, Vision, And Retirement As Standard), We Are Also Very Proud To Offer a Few Additional Initiatives To Future Nitronauts:

Hybrid Work

Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.

Benefits:

Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.

Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. We invite you to join us. Why?

When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.

Responsibilities

Our newest opportunity is for a talented K2 Developer
, seconded to our Client from government sector in Doha, Qatar
.

This position is available on a 6-month short-term contract
, supporting the project’s immediate requirements.

The successful candidate will be designing, building, configuring, and maintaining enterprise-grade business process applications using the K2 product suite (K2 Five / K2 Cloud / Nintex Automation). This role transforms manual, paper-based, or fragmented workflows into streamlined, automated digital applications. The position collaborates with business analysts and IT teams to implement data models, user interfaces, and automated workflows that improve organizational efficiency, governance, and system connectivity.

We envisage success in this role to include;

K2 Application Architecture & Design
Workflow Modeling:
Translate complex business process maps into functional K2 automated workflows, utilizing advanced rules, inline functions, and conditional routing logic.
Smart Forms Development:
Design high-fidelity, responsive user interfaces using K2 Smart Forms, incorporating custom views, controls, validation rules, and expressions.
Smart Objects Integration:
Create and configure reusable K2 Smart Objects to establish secure data handshakes between K2 applications and external databases or SaaS platforms.

Integration & Core Engineering
API & System Integration:
Connect K2 workflows with core enterprise ecosystems (e.g., SharePoint, SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) via REST/SOAP Web Services and custom Service Brokers.
Database Programming:
Write, optimize, and maintain underlying SQL Server database components, including stored procedures, views, and complex triggers tied to K2 processes.
Custom Code Extension:
Author custom .NET/C# code snippets, custom assembly brokers, or custom Smart Forms controls to extend K2 platform capabilities when out-of-the-box features fall short.

Maintenance, Administration & Optimization
Platform Administration:
Troubleshoot failed workflow instances, manage server logs, configure environmental string fields, and handle package deployments using K2 Management and K2 Package & Deployment.
Performance Tuning:
Audit and refactor inefficient Smart Object queries and deeply nested Smart Form rules to minimize server-side processing times and form load latches.
Technical Documentation:
Create and update Technical Design Documents (TDD), environment migration playbooks, and structural data dictionaries for all custom K2 builds

Qualifications

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a heavy emphasis on business process management (BPM) systems
, partnered with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.

Furthermore, you should demonstrate:
Dedicated K2 Experience:
At least 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise applications explicitly built over K2 Five or K2 Cloud.
Enterprise Integration Track Record:
Proven experience successfully integrating K2 ecosystems with at least two standard enterprise architectures (such as SharePoint Online, Oracle, other ERP’s or Databases).
K2 Core Architecture:
Deep mastery of the K2 product suite (K2 Five or K2 Cloud), including K2 Designer, Smart Objects, Smart Forms, K2 Workflow, K2 Management, and K2 Workspace.
Database Programming:
Expert proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, advanced T-SQL scripting, writing optimized stored procedures, and complex views.
Software Development:
Strong programming foundations in .NET, C#, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (useful for extending out-of-thebox Smart Forms).
K2 Specific Credentials:
Nintex/K2 Certified Specialist, K2 Five Core Developer, or Nintex Automation Cloud Practitioner/Developer certifications.
Microsoft Ecosystem Certifications:
Microsoft Certified: AzureDeveloper Associate or relevant legacy certificates in SQL Server / .NET development.

KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.

We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

je energie krijgt van eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid;
je zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook graag samenwerkt met collega's;
je enthousiast wordt van een omgeving waarin technologie continu in ontwikkeling is;
je graag werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en nieuwe technologieën;
je het leuk vindt om zowel backend als frontend op te pakken.

Je kijkt verder dan individuele features en denkt vanuit het grotere geheel. Je begrijpt hoe systemen samenhangen, hebt oog voor technische verbeteringen en combineert analytisch vermogen met een pragmatische, hands-on instelling. Je schrijft onderhoudbare, testbare en goed gedocumenteerde code.

Medior Full Stack Developer

Circa 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Basiskennis van frontendontwikkeling met React of Angular.
Basiskennis van cloudtechnologie en CI/CD.
Interesse om je verder te ontwikkelen op het gebied van AI, RAG en Elasticsearch.

Senior Full Stack Developer

Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Ervaring met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Brede ervaring met Azure, GitHub, CI/CD en cloud deployment.
Ervaring met Elasticsearch en AI-oplossingen zoals Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
In staat om architectuurkeuzes te maken, richting te geven aan technische ontwikkelingen en collega's te coachen.

Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk..
Ben je woonachtig in Nederland zodat je ook op kantoor met collega’s kunt verbinden.

Zonder CROW zou Nederland er heel anders uit zien. Zodra je de deur uitgaat en om je heen kijkt, zie je een openbare ruimte en infrastructuur die is vormgegeven met behulp van onze richtlijnen, systematieken en praktische tools. CROW ontwikkelt deze breed gedragen collectieve richtlijnen en kennis samen met belangrijke partijen als opdrachtgevers, opdrachtnemers, adviseurs en toeleveranciers. Wij vervullen hierbij een belangrijke verbindende rol.

CROW faciliteert kennisdeling, bevordert kennistoepassing en duidt beschikbare informatie. CROW richt zich hierbij op de praktijk van vandaag en morgen. CROW bevindt zich in de overgangsfase van een traditioneel kennisbedrijf naar een kennisbedrijf wat zich ook op de digitalisering van deze kennis richt. Een belangrijk doel is om de gebruikers van de kennis van CROW (onze klanten) zo optimaal mogelijk te bedienen door de juiste content in de juiste vorm en juiste samenhang digitaal aan te bieden in het werkproces van de klant.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to

models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The newComputational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients Worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

As a senior lab automation software engineer, you will be the essential link to the automation scientists in the lab. Using your background in both software development and hardware integration, you will work with a team of software-focused engineers to build, test and do what is needed to bring the software and hardware layers into production.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

Design, program and troubleshoot high-throughput lab workflows
Build orchestration systems, hardware abstraction layers, and instrument drivers that manage retries and allow unattended operation
Implement logging, metrics, and alerts across hardware and software to identify failures. Fix root causes using software or vision models instead of relying on manual workarounds or vendor support
Build systems to maintain a digital representation of the lab, including sample identity, instrument state, and resource availability. Connect instruments via APIs and integrate with LIMS and ELNs
Manage hardware requirements, site constraints, reagent selection, and work cell integration from initial design to deployment
Work directly with software engineers, automation scientists, and hardware engineers to turn scientific processes into technical architectures

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering and hardware integration
Experienced in programming commercial liquid-handling or laboratory automation platforms and integrating robotic manipulators
Proficient in C# or Python for building software and integration frameworks
Familiar with molecular biology, biochemistry, or wet lab workflows to help translate scientific needs into engineering solutions
Prototyping design experience, including CNC milling, laser cutting, and CAD
A clear communicator who collaborates with scientists and multidisciplinary teams to build complete solutions
Skilled at using APIs and SDKs to interact with complex laboratory software ecosystems
Experienced in designing workflow orchestration or scheduling systems that manage shared resources, dependencies, and priorities

Preferred Skills And Experience

Skilled with computer vision models (such as OpenCV, YOLO, or SAM) for automated error handling and object or anomaly detection
Experienced in training, evaluating, or adopting AI/ML models, including reinforcement or imitation learning for robotics
Capable of building and evaluating AI-enabled systems, defining evals, establishing guardrails for determinism versus nondeterminism, and measuring reliability
Knowledgeable about sensors, microcontrollers, and task-and-motion planning
Familiar with cloud infrastructure and digital twin simulation

A cover letter is not necessary, you will be required to fill a questionnaire.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity! #ComputationCoE

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 and has its headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in the public and private sectors across Europe.

At Netcompany we are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. We rely on one another and we develop quickly. From assisting small businesses to undertaking significant government projects, our innovative IT solutions are making a difference. Our culture emphasizes agility and flexibility, with minimal bureaucracy. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

As we prepare for new ventures, we are seeking ambitious individuals to join us on this journey.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and assist you in achieving your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague ensures your well-being and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies, and management to communication. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, which ensures that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise, allowing you to be well-prepared to handle various tasks and continually improve throughout your career with us.

Job Description

As a Junior .Net Developer you will:

Analyse, and understand business and technical requirements and work with clients across different domains and industries
Produce high-quality design deliverables that describe how the solution will accommodate business and technical requirements
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code using the best practices and design patterns
Conduct unit and manual testing and deliver high-quality solutions.
Identify bottlenecks, bugs and devise solutions to troubleshoot and address issues
Work in an agile, international environment with experienced and skilled colleagues in Warsaw and Europe
Plan and organize your own work and accurately report issues and progress in a timely manner
Identify areas for own personal development
You will get a chance to work with different programming languages and technologies as those vary from project to project, a large part of our tech stack is Microsoft (.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core) with automated deployments utilizing tools like Azure DevOps, Docker, SonarQube, and Git

Qualifications

A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a relevant IT specialization is required
Fully flexible and open to working with various technological platforms and tools
Strong willingness to improve programming skills and take on new IT challenges
A basic understanding of object-oriented programming is a must
Excellent communication, and collaboration abilities
Proficiency in the English language is required

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritise community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

Our Perks And Benefits

Scandinavian work environment
Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card
English and Danish language lessons
Drinks, snacks & fruit available at the office
Career development program for each employee and regular feedback
Internal and external training and certifications
International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK and Vietnam
Attractive offices with a great location in Warsaw: Puławska 180 (Metro Wilanowska) and Wronia 10 (Metro Rondo Daszyńskiego)

Send us your application

Please upload your CV to our recruitment system via the link. If you haven't received answers to all your questions, feel free to reach out to pl.hr@netcompany.com

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email HR at pl.hr@netcompany.com for assistance.

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

On a daily basis you will

Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.

At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior AI Cloud Architect (AI Platform)- Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tietoevry Public 360 - building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

What You Will Do

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.

Nice to have

Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

Impact you will have

Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Tech we use

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

Practicalities

Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Som AI Solution Architect på Tieto Tech Consulting kommer du att ingå i ett expanderande team i en utvecklande miljö. I din konsultroll kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med kollegor med varierande kompetens inom roller som arkitekter, utvecklare och projektledare.

Du kommer att få möjlighet att arbeta med att designa, utveckla och implementera AI-baserade lösningar för våra kunder. Arbetet innebär att förstå kunders behov och omsätta dessa till skalbara och hållbara arkitekturer, där AI är en central komponent. I rollen kommer du att arbeta både in-house och ute hos kund samt vara med och skapa lösningar som förenklar vardagen för många människor.

Hos Tieto Tech Consulting finns det stora möjligheter till utveckling. Du får arbeta med meningsfulla projekt i en öppen organisationskultur där kompetensutbyte uppskattas. Vi arbetar med moderna teknologier inom exempelvis AI, DevSecOps, Cloud native och IaC och levererar lösningar till kunder med höga krav på säkerhet och tillförlitlighet.

Skallkrav:

Minst 3 års erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling inom Java, Python, Go, Ruby, Javascript eller motsvarande.
Akademisk utbildning inom mjukvaruutveckling (MSc/BSc) eller motsvarande
Erfarenhet av design och utveckling av AI-baserade lösningar
Erfarenhet av IaC och DevOps, CI/CD eller DevSecOps
Flytande svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift

Meriterande erfarenheter:

Analysera kundbehov och ta fram lösningsarkitektur i samarbete med andra
LLM-applikationsarkitektur (t.ex. RAG, agenter, orkestrering, minnesdesign, NLP)
Retrieval och kunskapsmodellering (vector search, hybrid search, graf/semantik)
AI governance, utvärdering och livscykelhantering
Linux
Infrastrukturverktyg som Ansible och Terraform
Containerplattformar som Podman, Docker, Kubernetes och OpenShift
Virtualisering (t.ex. ProxMox, VMware, KVM)
Nätverk (NETCONF, BGP, BFD, L2/L3, VRF etc)
Molntjänster (AWS, Azure eller motsvarande)
Arbete i säkerhetsklassade projekt

Personliga egenskaper

Du är en person som är driven, nyfiken och initiativtagande. Att samarbeta tillsammans med ditt team ser du som en självklarhet. Du brinner för att lösa kundproblem och vill stötta dem på bästa möjliga sätt in i framtidens IT. Du gillar att utvecklas både i ditt arbete och som person.

Stationeringsort
: Kalmar eller Stockholm, kombinerat med möjlighet att arbeta på distans.

Låter det intressant?

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Bifoga ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil så kontaktar vi dig. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande, så vi uppmuntrar dig att ansöka redan idag! Om du har ytterligare frågor om rollen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryterande team lead Martin Adolfsson, martin.adolfsson@tieto.com

Vi utför bakgrundskontroller av alla slutkandidater.

Tieto avböjer samtal från rekryteringsföretag.

Om Tieto

Tieto skapar meningsfull teknologi som bidrar till att göra världen bättre. Vi är ett ledande techbolag med lång historia och närvaro i Norden men har också global kapacitet. Baserat på våra kärnvärden öppenhet, trovärdighet och mångfald, jobbar vi tillsammans med våra kunder – och utvecklar en digital framtid där företag, samhällen och människor kan växa.

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Job Description

The Senior MES Engineer will design, implement, and optimize Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions across AbbVie’s global manufacturing network, directly supporting the MES COE Lead’s strategic vision for digital transformation and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Collaborate with the MES COE Lead and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality MES solutions aligned with enterprise strategy and standards.
Lead technical design, configuration, integration, and testing of MES applications for multiple manufacturing modalities and sites.
Develop, document, and maintain MES best practices, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Lead Communities of Practice (COP) meetings across AbbVie’s processes and Champion template standardization and process simplification using advanced MES capabilities.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to MES engineers and collaborators.
Support Adoption of New MES technology and digital transformation initiatives at the site and network levels.
Analyse manufacturing processes and data to identify areas for MES-driven process improvement, automation, and harmonization.
Ensure compliance with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and AbbVie’s ways of working in all MES engineering activities.
Contribute to governance, technical documentation, and training programs for MES solutions.
Support New Instance MES program delivery through Global Recipe Templates.
Engage with internal and external partners (technology, automation, operations, IT) to support MES initiatives and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Science, IT, or related field.
3+ years experience with MES in pharmaceutical manufacturing, automation, or regulated environments.
Solid understanding of digital manufacturing concepts, MES technology operation, and enterprise IT/OT integration.
Experience with process improvement, system analysis, and technical documentation in multi-site/global environments.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams and communicate effectively across business and technology.
Working knowledge of cGMP, pharma regulatory standards, and quality compliance.
Experience with MES platforms preferably POMS Aquila
Ability to train/mentor junior staff and contribute to knowledge sharing across the network.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills

Ownership & Accountability:

Responsible for delivering high-quality MES engineering solutions that achieve strategic and operational goals set by the COE Lead.
Maintains high standards of process compliance and actively supports a culture of innovation and continuous improvement in MES operations.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior AI Cloud Architect (AI Platform)- Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tietoevry Public 360 - building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

What You Will Do

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.

Nice to have

Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

Impact you will have

Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Tech we use

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

Practicalities

Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)

who thrives in an AI-first world – designing modern data platforms, leveraging AI-driven development
, and shaping how organizations turn data into intelligent action? Do you combine strong data engineering foundations with a software engineering mindset, and enjoy building, not just designing?

for our clients in Europe. You will work alongside top professionals in data and AI development
in Finland, collaborating with global data and software teams to design impactful solutions that drive business value.
